title: Adaptive Layouts and Navigation 3 Concepts Check

questions.prompt: What should drive a phone-versus-two-pane decision?
questions.explanation: Available application bounds and posture can change independently of the physical device category.

questions.prompt: A resize should create a separate copy of selected-item state for each pane.
questions.explanation: One hoisted identity preserves continuity across presentation changes.

questions.prompt: What owns the Navigation 3 back stack?
questions.explanation: Navigation 3 renders app-managed keys through NavDisplay and scene strategies.
